name: Unagida Nagiko
source: A devout believer of the Banana Cult who has been active in Shibuya for decades. She's also one of the Banana Girls, the cult leader's inner circle of aides. With a background in martial arts, she enforces discipline on anyone who defies the leader or tries to leave the cult. Her signature move: "Great Buhenmono – Banana."
